beanie.why: SEVERE — WRONG WORD, NOT A WRONG FORM. 'Mossa' is MOSS (the plant, Bryophyta). The hat is 'mössa'. This is diacritic loss (ö -> o) producing a real but entirely different Swedish word, so no spellcheck or net catches it: a child sees a hat and hears/reads 'moss'. Both spellings are real words, which is exactly why it survived

blocks.why: 'Klossar' is a plural form standing in the singular field (the defect class named in the brief). SAOL: kloss subst. ~en ~ar. The lemma singular is 'kloss'; the image may show several blocks, but the singular field must hold the singular (a counting exercise needs '1 kloss / 2 klossar').

boots.why: A plural form in the singular field. SAOL: stövel subst. ~n, pl. stövlar (syncope). NOT pluralia tantum — unlike 'byxor'/'glasögon', 'stövel' has a living singular (en stövel). The image probably shows a pair; the singular field must still hold the singular.

cheeks.why: 'Kinder' is the PLURAL of 'kind' standing in the singular field. SAOL: en kind, kinden, kinder. (Not German 'Kinder' = children — the Swedish form is a genuine plural of kind.)

clementine.why: Spelling: SAOL has 'klementin' with k. The stored singular 'Clementin' is an unassimilated spelling that contradicts its own plural 'Klementiner' in the same row — this is what N5 detected

crutches.why: 'Kryckor' is a PLURAL standing in the singular field. This is NOT pluralia tantum: unlike glasögon/byxor, 'en krycka' is entirely normal Swedish, so a singular exists and belongs here

cymbals.why: 'Cymbaler' is a PLURAL standing in the singular field. 'en cymbal' exists, so this is not pluralia tantum

dice.why: The singular field holds a PLURAL form. English 'Dice' is the plural of 'die'; Swedish has a live singular: en tärning -> flera tärningar. Not pluralia tantum.

eyelashes.why: The singular field holds a PLURAL form. Unlike 'glasögon'/'byxor', 'ögonfrans' is NOT pluralia tantum — en ögonfrans -> flera ögonfransar is live Swedish. The English gloss being plural-only does not make the Swedish word plural-only.

ice-skate.why: A PLURAL is sitting in the singular field — the known defect class. The English gloss is singular ('Ice Skate'); Swedish singular is 'en skridsko'. 'Skridskor' is its plural.

kangaroo.why: MISSPELLING: the Swedish word is 'känguru' with ä. 'Kanguru' is not Swedish (it is the German/Dutch shape) and is not in SAOL. This is the only outright misspelled headword in the batch.

lilac.why: SAOL spells the shrub 'syren', without the acute accent. 'Syrén' is not the SAOL form.

native-american.why: The singular field holds the PLURAL: en indian -> flera indianer. Singular is 'Indian'. SEPARATE CONTENT FLAG (not a form matter, raised for the operator): Språkrådet regards 'indian' as dated and contested; a children's site may want 'urfolk i Amerika' / 'nordamerikansk urbefolkning'. That is a lemma/appropriateness decision beyond this audit

octopus.why: MISSPELLING: 'Blackfisk' is not a Swedish word. The word is 'bläckfisk' (bläck = ink). The missing umlaut makes this a non-word that a child would both see projected and hear read aloud

santa.why: 'Jultomten' is the DEFINITE form ('the Santa'). The file's convention is the bare indefinite form without definiteness (cf. 'Katt', not 'Katten'). The indefinite singular is 'en jultomte'

santa-claus.why: same defect as key 'santa': 'Jultomten' is the definite form; the bare indefinite is 'en jultomte'

sink.why: 'Diskbank' IS NOT A SWEDISH WORD — it is a misspelling of 'diskbänk' (disk + bänk = 'washing-up bench'). A child would be shown and read a non-word. Pure spelling fix of the same lemma.

ambulance.why: en ambulans -> flera ambulanser; French-type loans in stressed -ans take -er (chans -> chanser, allians -> allianser). 'Ambulansar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish form

antelope.why: en antilop -> flera antiloper; loans with final-syllable stress take -er (ballong -> ballonger, balkong -> balkonger). 'Antilopar' is the script's default -ar

apple-pie.why: en paj -> flera pajer; 'pajar' is not a Swedish form (script default -ar)

armchair.why: en fatolj -> flera fatoljer; French loan (fauteuil) with final stress takes -er. 'Fatoljar' is the script default

aster.why: en aster -> flera astrar; -er nouns syncopate the stem vowel (syster -> systrar, åker -> åkrar). 'Asterar' is the script's default -ar bolted onto an unsyncopated stem and is not a Swedish word

asteroid.why: en asteroid -> flera asteroider; -oid loans take -er. 'Asteroidar' is the script default

avocado.why: en avokado -> flera avokador; common-gender -o loans take -r (flamingo -> flamingor, dynamo -> dynamor). 'Avokados' is an English -s plural, not a Swedish form (it circulates colloquially but is not the dictionary form)

baby-overall.why: en overall -> flera overaller; the -er declension. 'Overallar' is the script's default -ar

bagel.why: en bagel -> flera baglar; -el nouns syncopate (cykel -> cyklar, nyckel -> nycklar, sockel -> socklar). 'Bagels' in the data is the English -s plural and is not a Swedish plural form at all

baguette.why: en baguette -> flera baguetter; -e loans take -r. 'Baguettar' is the script default and is not a word

balloon.why: en ballong -> flera ballonger; -ong loans with final stress take -er. 'Ballongar' is the script default and is not a word

bathing-suit.why: en drakt -> flera drakter; 'baddraktar' is the script's default -ar and is not a word

beach-umbrella.why: ett parasoll -> flera parasoll; consonant-final neuter takes zero plural. 'Parasollar' is the script's default -ar, applied because the word was missing from SV_ETT_WORDS — the exact camp/Lagerar failure, with BOTH fields wrong from ONE cause

beanie.why: en mössa -> flera mössor. The declension was applied correctly — to the wrong lemma ('mossa' -> 'mossor' is also valid, for moss), so the plural silently inherits the same corruption

blender.why: en mixer -> flera mixrar; -er nouns syncopate (container -> containrar, aster -> astrar). 'Mixerar' is the script's default -ar on an unsyncopated stem and is not a Swedish word

bow.why: SAOL: rosett subst. ~en ~er. En rosett -> två rosetter. 'Rosettar' is the script's default -ar applied to a final-stressed loanword that takes -er; it is not a Swedish word.

bowling-ball.why: SAOL: klot subst. ~et, plural unchanged. Ett klot -> flera klot. 'Bowlingkloter' is an invented word.

briefcase.why: SAOL: portfölj subst. ~en ~er. En portfölj -> två portföljer (final-stressed French loan; -er, not the script's default -ar). 'Portföljar' is not a Swedish word.

bulldozer.why: -er nouns syncopate and take -ar — exactly the class the brief names (nyckel->nycklar, cykel->cyklar, finger->fingrar); for -er machine loans SAOL documents container->containrar, revolver->revolvrar, trailer->trailrar. 'Bulldozerar' has neither the syncope nor a valid ending and is not a Swedish word.

cabana.why: SAOL: hytt subst. ~en ~er. En hytt -> två hytter. 'Strandhyttar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish form. (If the singular is ever changed to 'badhytt', the plural is 'badhytter' — same declension.)

cabbage.why: 'Kål' is a mass/collective noun (SAOL: kål ~en, no plural listed); one says 'olika kålsorter', not 'kålar'. 'Kålar' is the script's default -ar and would only be read as 'kinds of cabbage' — not child-level. Structural check: kål is UTRUM, and an utrum noun cannot have a zero plural, so p=s can only be NO_PLURAL here. If a countable plural is ever needed, the lemma must change to 'kålhuvud' (t, zero plural) — that is a lemma decision for the operator, not a form fix.

camp.why: SAOL: ett läger -> flera läger (zero plural, neuter). 'Lägerar' is not a Swedish word. Confirmed independently, not merely copied from the brief.

cardinal.why: SAOL: kardinal ~en ~er. En kardinal -> två kardinaler (final-stressed -al loan, like general -> generaler, amiral -> amiraler). 'Kardinalar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

carrot.why: SAOL: morot subst. ~en, pl. morötter. En morot -> flera morötter — UMLAUT (like rot -> rötter, fot -> fötter), which the brief notes the script cannot do at all. 'Moroter' is not a Swedish word, and this is one of the most common words a Swedish preschooler knows.

cast.why: 'Gipsar' is not a Swedish word under any reading. As the material, 'gips' is a mass noun; as the object on an arm (themes=hospital, en=Cast/Casts) it is a neuter consonant-final noun with a zero plural: ett gips -> flera gips. Both readings give the same form, so the fix is unambiguous even though the two analyses differ.

caterpillar.why: SAOL: larv subst. ~en ~er. En larv -> flera larver (the biological term: fjärilslarver, mygglarver). 'Larvar' is the script's default -ar and is not the plural of the insect sense. (Aside: 'larv' also means 'nonsense', but that sense has no plural at all — it cannot rescue 'larvar' either.)

cauliflower.why: As `cabbage`: 'blomkål' is a mass/collective noun (SAOL: blomkål ~en, no plural listed); a countable head is 'ett blomkålshuvud'. 'Blomkålar' is the script's default -ar. Structural check: blomkål is utrum, so p=s can only be NO_PLURAL, never a zero plural.

caulking-gun.why: SAOL: pistol subst. ~en ~er. En pistol -> två pistoler (final-stressed loan; cf. limpistol -> limpistoler). 'Fogpistolar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

cedar-tree.why: -er nouns syncopate and take -ar — the class the brief names (nyckel->nycklar, fjäder->fjädrar, syster->systrar). En ceder -> flera cedrar. 'Cederar' has no syncope and is not a Swedish form.

chameleon.why: SAOL: kameleont subst. ~en ~er. En kameleont -> flera kameleonter. The stored p equals s, i.e. the entry claims a zero plural — but zero plural is a NEUTER property, and 'kameleont' is utrum (the entry's own 'n'), so the data is internally impossible as well as wrong.

cheeks.why: SAOL: en kind -> flera kinder (2nd declension -er). 'Kinderar' is not a Swedish word — the script appended its default -ar to an already-plural form

cheetah.why: SAOL: en gepard -> flera geparder (-er, not the script's default -ar). Stressed final -ard loans take -er: cf. leopard -> leoparder, standard -> standarder, boulevard -> boulevarder. 'Gepardar' is not Swedish

chimpanzee.why: SAOL: en schimpans -> flera schimpanser (-er). Loans with stress on a final -ans take -er (cf. elefant -> elefanter, leverans -> leveranser). The script's default -ar produced the non-word 'Schimpansar'

chipmunk.why: SAOL: en ekorre -> flera ekorrar, so jordekorre -> jordekorrar. The stored 'Jordekorrrar' has THREE r's — a typo on top of the rule; it is not a word in any spelling

clover.why: 'Klöver' as a plant is a collective/mass noun — 'det växer klöver på ängen'; one does not count *tre klövrar (a child counts 'klöverblad'). p = s is the correct encoding. Note in any case that 'Klöverar' is impossible: -er nouns syncopate (åker -> åkrar, syster -> systrar), so even a hypothetical plural could never be *klöverar

coconut.why: SAOL: en nöt -> flera nötter, so kokosnöt -> kokosnötter. The script's default produced the non-word 'Kokosnötar'

coconut-tree.why: SAOL: en palm -> flera palmer (-er), so kokospalm -> kokospalmer. 'Kokospalmar' is the script's default -ar and is not Swedish

comet.why: SAOL: en komet -> flera kometer (-er; final-stressed loan). 'Kometar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

compass.why: SAOL: en kompass -> flera kompasser (-er; final-stressed loan). 'Kompassar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

cone.why: SAOL: en kon -> flera koner (-er). 'Konar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

controller.why: SAOL: en kontroll -> flera kontroller (-er; final-stressed loan), so handkontroll -> handkontroller. 'Handkontrollar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

crocodile.why: SAOL: en krokodil -> flera krokodiler (-er; final-stressed loan). 'Krokodilar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

curtains.why: SAOL: en gardin -> flera gardiner. 'Gardinerar' is not a Swedish word — the script appended its default -ar to an already-plural form, exactly the 'cheeks'/'cymbals' failure

cymbals.why: SAOL: en cymbal -> flera cymbaler. 'Cymbalerar' is not a Swedish word — the script appended its default -ar to an already-plural form

cypress-tree.why: SAOL: en cypress -> flera cypresser (-er; final-stressed loan, cf. adress -> adresser, kongress -> kongresser). 'Cypressar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

dandelion.why: SAOL: en ros -> flera rosor (1st declension -or), so maskros -> maskrosor. 'Maskrosar' is the script's default and is not Swedish — no Swede says anything but 'maskrosor'

delivery.why: SAOL: en leverans -> flera leveranser (-er). Same final-stressed -ans class as 'schimpans' in this batch. 'Leveransar' is the script's default and is not Swedish

dishwasher.why: SAOL: maskin -> maskiner (declension 3). 'Diskmaskinar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

dolphin.why: SAOL: delfin -> delfiner (final-stressed loanword, declension 3). 'Delfinar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

dragon-fruit.why: SAOL: frukt -> frukter (declension 3). 'Drakfruktar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

dresser.why: SAOL: byrå -> byråer (en byrå, byrån, byråer, byråerna). 'Byråar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

dryer.why: -are nouns are unchanged in the indefinite plural: en torktumlare -> flera torktumlare. 'Torktumlar' is an invented form — the script's -el/-er vowel-drop half-rule misfired on an -are noun and amputated the final -e.

eclair.why: 'Eclairar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish form. Final-stressed French loans of this shape take -er (affär -> affärer, militär -> militärer). Residual uncertainty is only the spelling of the stem, not the -er ending.
eclair.src: SAOL declension pattern for final-stressed French loans (I am not citing a SAOL entry for this word)

eggplant.why: SAOL: aubergine -> auberginer (en aubergine, auberginen, auberginer). 'Auberginar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

electric-drill.why: SAOL: maskin -> maskiner. 'Borrmaskinar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

espresso-machine.why: SAOL: maskin -> maskiner. 'Espressomaskinar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

excavator.why: SAOL: maskin -> maskiner. 'Grävmaskinar' is the script's default -ar and is not a Swedish word.

face.why: ett ansikte -> flera ansikten. The script gave a vowel-final neuter a blank zero plural, which is right only for consonant-final neuters (hus, bord). 'Ansikte' as a plural is not Swedish.

ferret.why: SAOL: iller -> illrar (unstressed -er stem drops the vowel: åker -> åkrar, syster -> systrar). 'Illerar' is the script's default -ar bolted onto an undropped stem and is not a Swedish word.

fig.why: SAOL: ett fikon -> flera fikon. Fourth-declension neuter with zero plural. 'Fikonar' is an invented word.

fishbowl.why: SAOL: ett akvarium -> flera akvarier (Latin -ium loans: museum -> museer, laboratorium -> laboratorier). 'Fiskakvariumar' is an invented word. Note the two rules disagreed inside the script: genderSv's 'um' suffix rule fired (giving the correct 't'), but the pluraliser fell through to the default +ar.

flamingo.why: Unstressed -o utrum loans take -r, not -ar (kimono -> kimonor, sombrero -> sombreror). 'Flamingoar' is the script's default -ar. I am confident about the -r ending; flagging that I am asserting the declension pattern rather than quoting a SAOL entry verbatim.
flamingo.src: SAOL declension pattern for unstressed -o utrum loans

flute.why: SAOL: flöjt -> flöjter (declension 3, like the other instruments: gitarr -> gitarrer, trumpet -> trumpeter, fiol -> fioler). 'Flöjtar' is the script's default -ar.

garland.why: en girlang -> girlanger. Polysyllabic final-stressed -ang loans take -er (bumerang -> bumeranger, orangutang -> orangutanger); the -ar default belongs to native monosyllables like 'slang -> slangar'. 'Girlangar' is the script's default and is not the established form.

gazelle.why: en gasell -> gaseller. Final-stressed loan nouns take -er — exactly the class of the brief's own control word 'kamel -> kameler'. 'Gasellar' is the script's +ar default and is not a Swedish form.

goat.why: SAOL: en get -> flera getter (geten, getter, getterna). 'Getar' is the script's +ar default and is not a Swedish word — a child would be shown and read an invented form for a farm animal that every 3-7-year-old knows.

grapefruit.why: The head noun is 'frukt': en frukt -> frukter, so en grapefrukt -> grapefrukter. 'Grapefruktar' is the script's +ar default and is not a Swedish word. Head-noun inconsistency that no net flagged.

guitar.why: en gitarr -> gitarrer. Final-stressed loan noun, same class as kamel -> kameler and gasell -> gaseller. 'Gitarrar' is the script's +ar default and is not a Swedish word — this is a high-frequency word for the age group (theme music/toys).

hexagon.why: The two fields hold DIFFERENT LEMMAS: singular 'Sexhörning' (the native, child-appropriate word) but plural 'Hexagoner' (the learned loan). N5 is right for once. Resolved in favour of the singular field, which is the primary one and which matches the sibling key 'heptagon' (Sjuhörning -> Sjuhörningar): en sexhörning -> sexhörningar. A child shown 'Sexhörning' must not hear 'Hexagoner'.

hot-air-balloon.why: SAOL: ballong, ballongen, ballonger (3rd declension, -er). 'Luftballongar' is the script's default +ar and is not a Swedish form.

hot-dog.why: 'Korvar' is the plural of 'korv' alone (= sausages), not of the phrase 'korv med bröd'. The plural of the whole term inflects the head: en korv med bröd -> flera korvar med bröd. As it stands, the plural silently drops the bun and no longer matches the picture.

iguana.why: SAOL: leguan, leguanen, leguaner. Loanwords with stress on a final -an take -er (jfr pelikan -> pelikaner, tulpan -> tulpaner). 'Leguanar' is the script's default +ar.

jam.why: Mass noun in this image context (jam in a jar). 'Syltar' is in any case not a Swedish form — the script's default +ar. p should equal s.

jellyfish.why: SAOL: manet, maneten, maneter (3rd declension, -er). 'Manetar' is the script's default +ar and is not a Swedish form.

kangaroo.why: Wrong on both counts: the ä-spelling per SAOL, and the ending — unstressed-final-u loanwords take -er (jfr gnu -> gnuer, emu -> emuer), not the script's default +ar. 'Kanguruar' is not a Swedish word.
kangaroo.src: SAOL (spelling); -u loanword declension for the ending

kayak.why: SAOL: kajak, kajaken, kajaker (3rd declension, -er — stress on the final syllable; jfr barack -> baracker, attack -> attacker). 'Kajakar' is the script's default +ar.

knee.why: The brief's most productive defect class, and it is a body part a child will meet constantly: ett knä -> flera knän. Vowel-final neuters take -n, not zero plural. The script gave the blank zero plural, which is right only for consonant-final neuters (hus, bord).

komodo-dragon.why: SAOL: varan, varanen, varaner (-er; stress on the final -an, same class as leguan -> leguaner in this batch). 'Komodovaranar' is the script's default +ar.

lemur.why: SAOL: lemur, lemuren, lemurer (-er; stress on the final -ur, jfr figur -> figurer, frisyr -> frisyrer). 'Lemurar' is the script's default +ar.

liberty.why: Abstract noun. A plural 'friheter' exists in adult legal/political register ('rättigheter och friheter'), but it is not child-appropriate and does not correspond to anything picturable here. p should equal s.

librarian.why: SAOL: bibliotekarie, bibliotekarien, bibliotekarier. Nouns in -ie take -ier. 'Bibliotekariar' is the script's default +ar and is not a Swedish word.

lilac.why: Wrong on both counts: the accent (see singular) and the ending — SAOL: syren, syrenen, syrener (-er). 'Syrénar' is the script's default +ar.

lobster.why: SAOL: hummer, hummern, humrar — the -er syncope also SHORTENS the double consonant (exactly as sommar -> somrar, hammare -> hamrar). 'Hummrar' with -mmr- is not a possible Swedish spelling. Note this is a rare case where the script produced a wrong form even though it reached for the right declension.

manatee.why: en ko -> flera kor, so en sjöko -> flera sjökor. 'Sjökoar' is not a Swedish word; the script's default +ar rule fired on an irregular head noun

mask.why: The two senses have DIFFERENT plurals: en mask (ansiktsmask) -> masker, but en mask (djuret) -> maskar. The data carries 'Maskar' = worms, while themes accessories/hospital show a face mask. Exactly the pine-tree/Kiefer trap the brief warns about

medal.why: en medalj -> flera medaljer (3rd declension -er). 'Medaljar' is not a Swedish word; the script's default +ar rule fired

medical-chart.why: en journal -> flera journaler, so en patientjournal -> flera patientjournaler. 'Patientjournalar' is not a Swedish word

medicine.why: en medicin -> flera mediciner (stressed -in loans take -er: maskin->maskiner, vitamin->vitaminer). 'Medicinar' is not a Swedish word

muscles.why: 'Musklerar' is a fabricated DOUBLE plural — the script appended -ar to the already-plural 'muskler'. en muskel -> flera muskler is correct on any reading of the singular field

musician.why: en musiker -> flera musiker; -er agent nouns have zero plural. 'Musikerar' is not a Swedish word. Note the internal inconsistency: key 'mechanic' in this same batch stores the identical pattern CORRECTLY as Mekaniker/Mekaniker

native-american.why: 'Indianerar' is a fabricated DOUBLE plural — the script appended -ar to the already-plural 'indianer'

nectarine.why: en nektarin -> flera nektariner; stressed -in loans take -er (mandarin->mandariner, medicin->mediciner). 'Nektarinar' is not a Swedish word

oak-tree.why: en ek -> flera ekar (2nd declension -ar). 'Eker' is not the plural of 'ek' at all — it is a DIFFERENT lemma: en eker = a spoke of a wheel (plural ekrar). A child on a 'tree' page would be shown an oak and told the word for a bicycle spoke

octopus.why: Same misspelling carried into the plural. en bläckfisk -> flera bläckfiskar (fisk -> fiskar) is otherwise the right declension

oil.why: Mass noun (ämnesnamn) in the depicted sense: themes = at_the_supermarket, the English gloss has no plural, and countable is false. 'Oljor' is a real Swedish form but only in the sortal reading 'kinds of oil', which a bottle of cooking oil does not show. p should equal s. N1 flag agrees; this matches how 'milk' is already encoded

orangutan.why: Loans with a stressed final -ang take -er in Swedish: en bumerang -> bumeranger, en mustang -> mustanger. 'Orangutanger' is the established form in Swedish zoological and general usage; 'orangutangar' is the script's -ar default misfiring
orangutan.src: Swedish declension of stressed -ang loans (bumerang, mustang); established usage 'orangutanger'

outlet.why: ett uttag -> flera uttag, so ett eluttag -> flera eluttag (consonant-final neuter, zero plural). 'Eluttagar' is not a Swedish word. TWO FIELDS, ONE CAUSE: 'uttag' is simply absent from the script's hand-written SV_ETT_WORDS list, so it got gender n AND the default +ar plural — exactly the coupled defect the brief describes with 'läger'
outlet.src: SAOL (uttag; cf. ett tag, ett intag)

oval.why: en oval -> flera ovaler; loans with a stressed final -al take -er (en lokal -> lokaler, en spiral -> spiraler, en katedral -> katedraler). 'Ovalar' is not a Swedish word. This one is on a shapes page, where the plural is read aloud constantly

oyster.why: SAOL: ett ostron -> flera ostron (neuter, zero plural, like päron/plommon in this same batch). 'Ostronar' is not a Swedish word

palette.why: SAOL: en palett -> paletter (3rd declension -er, as with all stressed -ett loans: servett->servetter, cigarett->cigaretter). The script's default -ar is wrong here

palm-tree.why: SAOL: en palm -> palmer (3rd declension -er). 'Palmar' is the script's default -ar rule misfiring

parasol.why: SAOL: ett parasoll -> flera parasoll (neuter, consonant-final, zero plural). 'Parasollar' is not a Swedish word

pegasus.why: Egennamn: Pegasus is the proper name of the one winged horse of Greek myth; Swedish has no everyday plural (the English gloss 'Pegasuses' notwithstanding). 'Pegasusar' should be dropped and p set equal to s

pelican.why: SAOL: en pelikan -> pelikaner (3rd declension -er, like all stressed -an loans: banan->bananer, orkan->orkaner, roman->romaner). 'Pelikanar' is the script's default -ar misfiring

piano.why: SAOL: ett piano -> flera pianon. Vowel-final neuters take -n (4th declension); the script's blanket neuter zero plural is right only for consonant-final neuters

pie.why: SAOL: en paj -> pajer (3rd declension -er). 'Pajar' is the script's default -ar misfiring; cf. äppelpajer, not *äppelpajar

pineapple.why: SAOL: en ananas -> ananaser (3rd declension -er). 'Ananasar' is the script's default -ar misfiring. NB the -as ending does NOT license -ar generally: pyjamas->pyjamasar in this same batch is a genuine -ar word — judged word by word, not by pattern

pipe-wrench.why: Umlaut plural, which the script cannot do at all: SAOL en tång (verktyg) -> tänger, hence rörtång -> rörtänger. 'Rörtångar' is not a Swedish word

plant.why: SAOL: en växt -> växter (3rd declension -er). 'Växtar' is the script's default -ar misfiring and is not a Swedish word

plate.why: SAOL: en tallrik -> tallrikar (2nd declension -ar). 'Tallriker' is not a Swedish word — note this one is NOT the -ar default misfiring but an over-correction away from it
